result.topic_en: Draft notes on rational functions of two variables linked by an algebraic equation F(s,z)=0. The notes count branch values and arbitrary constants of the function z, and conclude that a class of equally branched systems on a (2p+1)-fold connected surface depends on 3p−3 continuously variable moduli.

methods.what: Count of branch values of rational functions of s and z, viewed as functions of z (simple poles), on a surface of connectivity 2p+1 (genus p)
methods.quote:
so ist die Anzahl der
Verzweigungswerthe der rationalen [-Ausdrücke-] von s und z als Functionen von z, $2(\mu+p-1)$

methods.what: Count of arbitrary constants in the function z
methods.quote: die Anzahl der willkürlichen Constanten in [-desselben[?]-] der Function z, $2\mu-p+1$

methods.what: Moduli count: a class of equally branched systems depends on 3p−3 continuous parameters (branch values minus free constants)
methods.quote: hängt also von 3p−3 stetig veränderlichen Größen ab, welche die Moduln dieser Klasse genannt werden {+sollen+}

methods.what: Finiteness: fixing the branching type and the 3p−3 remaining branch values determines the functions in only finitely many ways, since the conditions are algebraic
methods.quote: dadurch nur auf eine endliche Anzahl von Arten, da die Bedingungsgleichungen algebraisch sind.

methods.what: Existence: for a given (2p+1)-fold connected surface there is always a system of algebraic functions generating it
methods.quote: so existirt immer ein System von diese Fläche erzeugender algebraischer Functionen.

items.english: A class of systems of equally branched (2p+1)-fold connected functions thus depends on 3p−3 continuously variable quantities.

items.quote:
Wenn andererseits [-..-] 3 Flächen[?] [?] (2p+1)fach zusammenhängende Fläche gegeben
sind, so existirt immer ein System von diese Fläche erzeugender algebraischer Functionen.
items.english: If, on the other hand, a (2p+1)-fold connected surface is given, there always exists a system of algebraic functions generating this surface.
